text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I reckon this'll be the main spot for the dorm decorations.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Dorm head! If you'll excuse me, I must take my leave here! I have a meeting with Trainer Kashimoto coming up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thanks a lot!
Sorry to ask, but could you help out tomorrow too?
We're short on hands to carry the luggage.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me!
It'll double as training, so no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Decorations won't be necessary, but this fridge alone might not be big enough to hold all the ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, shall I arrange for some refrigerated trucks?
If it's only a few, I can have them dispatched right away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you sure!? That's a lifesaver!
I'll apply for the parking spot, so let me know once you have the car model and details!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I will try to contact them right away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Decorate here, and...
Rearrange the tables so people can stand and eat on the day...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I heard that Hishi Ama-san is cooking all the meals all by herself...
So, um... Rice...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I was planning to cook a big feast,
but I was in a bind doing it alone... Rice,
would you mind lending me a hand?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
! Y-Yes...!
Rice will do her best...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's a dance party too, so it looks like it'll get crowded...
Maybe I should put up a notice or something.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Pick me, pick me! Me!
Turbo can write it! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha. All right, I'll leave it to you.
Make sure it says, 'Please take turns and avoid staying too long'!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Please step back after making your selection and do not linger!"
Got it--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Budget sheet verified, and notices compiled.
Smooth sailing, smooth sailing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'm sure
it'll be another great Christmas this year!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Above all, those girls have been working so hard,
finding time between their training sessions
to lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch, Fuji...!
We're definitely not losing to the Ritto dorm's Christmas...!!
